rule: A land entering while Blood Moon removes its abilities does not get its own enters-with counters (CR 614.12); Dark Depths with no ice counters triggers once the Moon is gone
solution_actions: LAND: Solver played Dark Depths (1)
STACK_ADD: Solver cast Ray of Revelation targeting [Blood Moon (11)]
misread_line: Cast Ray of Revelation on Blood Moon before playing Dark Depths (it enters with ten ice counters).
note: Uniqueness exhaustive (6/6): the Ray-first deviation was played out and fails. Log: Dark Depths played under the Moon, Ray destroys the Moon, Marit Lage created.

rule: You order your own simultaneous triggers (CR 603.3b); battle cry and Akroan Hoplite only count the Soldier tokens if the token trigger resolved first (CR 611.2c, 608.2h)
solution_actions: COMBAT: Solver assigned Hero of Bladehold (4), Nobilis of War (5) and Akroan Hoplite (6) to attack Opponent.
misread_line: Stacks the triggers so battle cry and/or the Hoplite resolve before the Soldier tokens exist (24 or 26 damage).
note: CAVEAT: the search arm never branches trigger order (PuzzleArms.subset with lo=hi=n returns the identity order), so the proof's 28 comes from the default order and 'unique' does not cover orders. Misread confirmed with the random arm (which does shuffle orders), 30 seeds: all-three attacks left the opponent at 2 (26 damage) and 4 (24 damage) in failing games, 28 in accepted ones (scratchpad rp/RP_002-rand).

rule: Dying is leaving the battlefield, so a leaves-the-battlefield trigger caused by a creature dying is doubled by Teysa Karlov; leaving another way is not
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver activated Spawning Pit
misread_line: Treats a creature dying as not leaving the battlefield for Teysa, so expects +2 from sacrificing the Riftwatcher and does not go for 24.
note: First board had Unsummon: second solution (Unsummon the Riftwatcher, then sacrifice it in response, Unsummon fizzles). Removed Unsummon. Ashnod's Altar replaced by Spawning Pit because the baseline arms are never offered sacrifice-cost mana abilities. Starts in MAIN2 so attacks add no extra solver actions.

rule: Damage stays marked until cleanup; a creature with lethal damage marked dies when it loses indestructible (CR 704.5g)
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Turn to Frog targeting [Darksteel Gargoyle (11)]
misread_line: Thinks the earlier damage is gone, so Turn to Frog cannot kill; Shocks the indestructible Gargoyle instead.
note: Uniqueness exhaustive; the Shock deviation fails. Turn to Frog makes it a 1/1 with 3 damage marked, it dies to SBA.

rule: Putting counters and then doubling them are two separate counter events, so Sharktocrab's ability triggers twice
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Biogenic Upgrade targeting [Sharktocrab (5)]
COMBAT: Solver assigned Sharktocrab (5) to attack Opponent.
misread_line: Expects one Sharktocrab trigger, so cannot tap both blockers (or splits counters onto other targets).
note: Uniqueness 6 of 8 deviations exhausted (not fully exhaustive). Random-arm log confirms two Sharktocrab triggers tapping Hill Giant and Grizzly Bears, then 10 to the face. Trigger targets are not in the solver 'actions', so swapping which trigger taps which creature is not counted as a second solution.

rule: Storm counts only spells cast before it this turn; the spells Finale of Promise casts are cast one at a time, in the order you choose
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Finale of Promise targeting [Evermind (6)] [Empty the Warrens (5)]
STACK_ADD: Solver cast Evermind
STACK_ADD: Solver cast Empty the Warrens
STACK_ADD: Solver cast Empty the Warrens
STACK_ADD: Solver cast Empty the Warrens
misread_line: Lets Empty the Warrens be cast first (storm count 1, four Goblins).
note: Three fixes: (1) Dark Ritual -> Evermind: the menu hid Finale of Promise entirely (harness defect, see REPORT); (2) acceptance token name is 'Goblin Token', not 'Goblin'; (3) library made non-land: the Evermind draw gave an optional land drop, a 'multiple'. The cast order is the choose-entity pick inside Finale's resolution, which the search does branch.

rule: A blocked trampler whose blockers have all left combat assigns all its damage to the player (CR 702.19e); a blocker that stays takes lethal damage first
solution_actions: COMBAT: Solver assigned Grizzly Bears (5) to block Colossal Dreadmaw (10).
misread_line: Blocks with Grizzly Bears and then returns it with Saving Grasp, expecting a blocked trampler with no blocker to deal no damage.
note: Rebuilt with the solver as the defender: the first version (solver attacking into a Lure-forced block) was proven through an opponent branch that declined to block, because the random/search arms ignore blocking requirements (harness defect, see REPORT). Random-arm log: block + Saving Grasp -> Dreadmaw deals 6 to the solver; block alone -> 2 to Bears, 4 trample.

rule: Cavalcade of Calamity triggers for each attacker with power 1 or less as it attacks; each noncombat hit pumps Chandra's Spitfire
solution_actions: COMBAT: Solver assigned Chandra's Spitfire (5), Raging Goblin (6) and Raging Goblin (7) to attack Opponent.
misread_line: Undercounts Cavalcade triggers and attacks with fewer than all three 1-power creatures.
note: Uniqueness exhaustive; every smaller attack falls short of 15.

rule: Blood Moon depends on Rootpath Purifier (CR 613.8): your lands become basic first, so Blood Moon no longer changes them
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Rootpath Purifier
STACK_ADD: Solver cast Unsummon targeting [Grizzly Bears (15)]
misread_line: Believes Blood Moon still wins, so pays for Rootpath Purifier with Tropical Island (red) and has no blue for Unsummon.
note: Forge agrees with the judge (dependency). The mana payment is a real branch ('mana: keep untapped 1'). Uniqueness exhaustive.

rule: Blood Moon depends on Life and Limb (CR 613.8a): the Saproling becomes a nonbasic Forest land, then a Mountain with "T: Add R"
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Lightning Bolt targeting [Opponent]
misread_line: Expects a Forest Saproling and casts Giant Growth (or attacks) instead of tapping the Saproling for red.
note: Forge agrees: the Saproling taps for R under Life and Limb + Blood Moon. Uniqueness exhaustive.

rule: Compleated and Doubling Season are both replacement effects on the enters-with loyalty; the controller chooses the order (CR 616.1): doubled then reduced is 10, reduced then doubled is 8
acceptance: counters p0 Battlefield "Vraska, Betrayal's Sting" LOYALTY = 10
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Vraska, Betrayal's Sting
misread_line: Applies Compleated before Doubling Season (8 loyalty).
note: Forge never offers the order: both replacement-order asks are single-option (AUTO-LEGAL forced-only-legal), yet the applied order varies between games (random arm, 30 seeds: life-paid casts gave 8 in some games and 10 in others with identical decisions; scratchpad rp/RP_011-rand/jvm.log). CR 616.1 gives the choice to the controller. The search 'proof' rides an engine-chosen order. First board (5 Swamps) was unprovable: Vraska never offered with exactly 4+B available (likely the menu does not price paying the Phyrexian symbol with life); 6 Swamps used instead.

rule: Doubling Season doubles the counters a permanent enters the battlefield with (CR 122.6, 614.1c)
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver activated Spawning Pit
misread_line: Expects the Familiar to return with 4 counters, so sees no way to reach 8 and leaves it alone.
note: Random-arm log: Familiar sacrificed to Spawning Pit, returns at end step with Doubling Season doubling 4 -> 8.

rule: Losing all abilities (layer 6) removes a characteristic-defining ability, so a */* creature becomes 0/0 and dies (CR 613.1f, 704.5f)
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Stop Cold targeting [Abomination of Llanowar (17)]
misread_line: Expects the Abomination to stay 5/5 under Stop Cold and Shocks it.
note: Forge agrees (CDA removed, 0/0, dies). Uniqueness exhaustive.

rule: Hushbringer stops enters-the-battlefield triggered abilities, not enters-with-counters replacement effects; Walking Ballista still enters with X counters
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Walking Ballista
STACK_ADD: Solver activated Walking Ballista targeting [Opponent]
STACK_ADD: Solver activated Walking Ballista targeting [Opponent]
misread_line: Thinks Ballista enters 0/0 under Hushbringer and never casts it.
note: Uniqueness exhaustive over 13 deviations (X choices, ping targets).

rule: A dies trigger that uses the creature's power uses its last-known information, pumps included (CR 608.2h)
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Cavalcade of Calamity
STACK_ADD: Solver activated Spawning Pit
misread_line: Thinks the dies trigger uses the 2 power of the card in the graveyard; sacrifices without the eerie pump or gives up.
note: Random-arm log: Cavalcade enters, eerie +2, Phantom sacrificed, dies trigger deals 4. Sacrificing first deals 2 (opponent at 2).

rule: A player who drew from an empty library loses only at the next state-based action check (CR 704.3, 704.5b); Jace's ability wins during its own resolution first
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver activated Jace, Wielder of Mysteries
misread_line: Fears decking from the -8 with three cards left (or uses +1) and never activates it.
note: Loyalty exactly 8, so Jace dies to SBA before his ability resolves and his replacement is gone: the win comes from the ability's own last sentence during resolution. Random-arm log confirms Jace to graveyard, then 'won due to effect of Jace'.

rule: City of Brass's damage is a triggered ability, while its mana ability resolves at once (CR 605.3b); make the mana first and cast Angel's Grace above the trigger
misread_line: Casts Angel's Grace paying with City of Brass during casting; the trigger resolves first and kills.
note: Not provable here: Angel's Grace is never offered to the arms (castable 0 with an untapped City of Brass at 1 life; likely the AI mana planner refusing a painful source), and floating mana from a land is offered only to the faithful seat, so the mana-first line cannot be played by the search arm. Evidence: scratchpad rp/RP_017-rand/game-1-*.jsonl.

rule: State-based actions are checked before triggered abilities are put on the stack (CR 704.3, 117.5); the opponent at 0 life loses before Baloth's life gain trigger
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Hopeless Nightmare
misread_line: Thinks Obstinate Baloth's life gain saves the opponent, so does not cast Hopeless Nightmare.
note: Random-arm log: Baloth replaced onto the battlefield, opponent 2 -> 0, game over before the Baloth trigger.

rule: Phyrexian Vindicator's redirected damage is a triggered ability; state-based actions end the game for the player at 0 life before it goes on the stack (CR 704.3, 603.3)
solution_actions: COMBAT: Solver assigned Durable Coilbug (4) and Bellowing Crier (5) to attack Opponent.
misread_line: Fears Vindicator's redirect kills both players and attacks with one creature (blocked) or none.
note: Proof beats both opponent replies (block either attacker). Random-arm log: Vindicator prevents 2, Crier deals 2, opponent loses before the trigger is put on the stack.

rule: You order your simultaneous dies triggers (CR 603.3b); Gift's return resolving first leaves the Adamantoise's exile with nothing to find, but its Treasures are still made
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver activated Spawning Pit
misread_line: Lets the Adamantoise's own trigger resolve first: it is exiled and Gift returns nothing.
note: CAVEAT as RP_002: trigger order is not branched by the search, the default order happens to be right. Misread confirmed with the random arm, 30 seeds: wrong order -> Adamantoise exiled with 10 Treasures (rejected), right order accepted.

rule: Deathtouch with trample: 1 damage is lethal to the blocker, the rest tramples over (CR 702.19c)
misread_line: assigns full toughness to the indestructible blocker
note: Not built: triage #2. The deciding choice is how to divide trample damage, which the search arm splits evenly instead of branching. Replaced by triage #21 (RP_020).

rule: An intervening-if trigger rechecks its condition on resolution (CR 603.4): the doubled Ophiomancer trigger makes a second Snake only if the first is gone by then
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver activated Glimmer Bairn
STACK_ADD: Solver activated Glimmer Bairn
misread_line: Expects two Snakes from the doubled trigger, so lets both triggers resolve and has one Snake (opponent at 1).
note: Two rebuilds. v1 (own upkeep, Spawning Pit, charge-counter acceptance) and v2 (Bastion + Spawning Pit) ran out of budget: Spawning Pit could sacrifice Ophiomancer or Prodigy at every priority stop. v3: the opponent's upkeep, and Glimmer Bairn (sacrifice a token only). Forge rechecks the condition: every sacrifice ask in the 119 rollouts was 'sacrifice(forced) -> Snake Token', so two Snakes never existed at once. Uniqueness exhaustive.

rule: A self-replacement effect (Twinstrike's hellbent "destroy instead") applies before other replacement effects (CR 614.15, 616.1a), so the Swans never prevent damage or draw
acceptance: count p1 Graveyard "Swans of Bryn Argoll" = 2
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Grizzly Bears
STACK_ADD: Solver cast Twinstrike targeting [Swans of Bryn Argoll (19), Swans of Bryn Argoll (20)]
misread_line: Casts Twinstrike first (the Swans prevent the damage and give four draws), or expects the Swans to make the solver draw even when hellbent.
note: Log: Twinstrike sends both Swans to the graveyard after Bears empties the hand. Uniqueness 7 of 27 deviations played out; most deviations are mana-payment orders.

rule: Kalitas's replacement effect applies to creatures that die at the same time as Kalitas (CR 614.1, 704.5g)
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Wrath of God
misread_line: Thinks Kalitas dying at the same time does not exile, so casts Murder on one creature (one Zombie).
note: Forge applies Kalitas to the creatures dying with it. Uniqueness exhaustive.

rule: The affected object's controller orders replacement effects (CR 616.1); Hardened Scales then Corpsejack Menace gives 12 counters, the other order 11
misread_line: Applies Corpsejack Menace before Hardened Scales (11 counters).
note: Forge never offers the order. Every replacement-order ask is '[Solver] [AUTO-LEGAL] replacement-order(forced-only-legal)', the same finding as RP_011. The 12 comes from the engine's own order, not a solver choice. Also, turning a morph face up is not a game-log action (actions: []), so uniqueness has nothing to compare.

rule: Two replacement effects that modify the same counter event each apply once, one after the other (CR 616.1, 614.5): X=4 gives six counters
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Endless One
misread_line: Expects one of the two replacements to apply (X=4 gives five), so pays X=5.
note: Uniqueness NOT exhaustive: 0 of 370 deviations played out within the budget (the first menu has 357 options with ten Wastes to float). Replacement order is forced-only-legal, but both orders give 6. Walking Ballista was replaced by Endless One: Ballista's ping and its {4} pump make X=5-then-ping and X=2-then-pump second solutions.

rule: Players get priority between the first-strike and regular combat damage steps; a creature that dealt no first-strike damage deals damage in the second step (CR 510.4, 702.7b)
misread_line: Equips Jadar before combat or before first-strike damage (7 damage).
note: Harness defect: the equip ability is never on the menu with Forge Anew's {0} alternative cost and no mana. The search log has no play decision at all, only attack choices (scratchpad rp2/RP_026-search/jvm.log). offerable() prices the printed {7}. A variant with seven Wastes is proven (scratchpad rp2v/RP_026b). The .pzl is kept for model evaluation.

rule: Negative power counts as negative in a sum of power and toughness (CR 208.4): -1/6 totals 5
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Cut Down targeting [Char-Rumbler (10)]
misread_line: Treats -1 power as 0 (total 6), so casts Tragic Slip or nothing.
note: Forge's totalPT_LE5 sums negative power. Cathar's Shield (+0/+3) puts the true total at exactly 5. Uniqueness exhaustive.

rule: A mutated creature that dies goes to the graveyard as separate cards; its undying returns each card with a +1/+1 counter (CR 702.140e, 702.93a)
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Gemrazer targeting [Young Wolf (5)]
STACK_ADD: Solver activated Spawning Pit
misread_line: Expects one merged return, or sacrifices Young Wolf alone first.
note: Gemrazer mutated onto Young Wolf, sacrificed, and both cards return with a counter. Uniqueness 6 of 10.

rule: The dies trigger uses last-known information: the counters the creature had just before it died, including +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters removed by the same state-based check (CR 704.8, 704.5q)
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Blight Rot targeting [Kinsbaile Borderguard (5)]
misread_line: Expects the counters to annihilate first (one token), so sacrifices the Borderguard to Spawning Pit (three tokens).
note: Forge uses LKI with all 7 counters. Uniqueness NOT exhaustive (0 of 6 within the budget).

rule: The Ozolith copies a dying creature's counters without removing them, so persist still sees the -1/-1 counter (CR 603.10a, 702.79a); the counter must be gone before the Clique dies
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver activated Spawning Pit
COMBAT: Solver assigned Craw Wurm (10) to attack Opponent.
misread_line: Sacrifices the Clique with its -1/-1 counter, expecting persist (it stays in the graveyard).
note: First run 'multiple': a second, harmless sacrifice of the returned Clique. Fixed with the acceptance line 'Puppeteer Clique = 1'. Line: the Ozolith moves its +1/+1 counter at beginning of combat, the counters annihilate, the Clique is sacrificed, persist returns it and it steals Craw Wurm, which attacks for 6. Uniqueness 9 of 10.

rule: A resolving instant or sorcery goes to the graveyard before state-based actions are checked, so it already counts for Consuming Blob's toughness (CR 608.2n, 704.3)
solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Pyroclasm
misread_line: Expects the Blob to die to Pyroclasm, so Shocks one Bear.

rule: A mode chosen more than once is carried out once per choice, in order (CR 700.2d); one regeneration shield replaces only the first destruction (CR 701.19a)
misread_line: Picks destroy x1 + damage x2, or destroy + destroy-the-Jar; the one regeneration shield saves the Golem.

With PZL_SEARCH_LINES=40 it is proven (modes 2 damage, destroy, destroy) and unique, 6 of 10 (scratchpad rp2v/RP_034-lines40). The .pzl is kept.

note: Log: Furnace Celebration triggers on 'Sacrificed: Endurance Bobblehead (5)', the Metamorph copy. Declining the copy makes a 0/0 that dies (no sacrifice). Uniqueness 8 of 23. The clone choice and the trigger payment are not game-log actions.

solution_actions: STACK_ADD: Solver cast Diabolic Edict targeting [Opponent]
misread_line: Thinks umbra armor also saves from sacrifice, so casts Murder.

note: Not built: Brute Force can target either Golem with the same five resolutions, so any board has two solutions; the count is visible only as combat damage.

rule: Each Ocelot Pride trigger copies every token created this turn, compounding
misread_line: expects six
note: Not built: the city's blessing and the tokens created this turn cannot be set in a puzzle state, and the two identical triggers have no order to choose.
